name: No-desolder reflash hack for Aubess WiFi power-monitor switch

mentions.name: No-desolder reflash hack for Aubess WiFi power-monitor switch
mentions.description: This project hardware-hacks a Chinese Aubess WiFi smart switch with a built-in power monitor so its firmware can be reflashed without desoldering any components.
mentions.problem: Reflashing the switch's firmware normally requires desoldering components from the board.
mentions.source_excerpt: My little project for today is sort of hardware hacking of Chinese Aubess WiFi switch with power monitor so I can reflash it without desoldering anything. :)

evidence.value: My little project for today is sort of hardware hacking of Chinese Aubess WiFi switch with power monitor so I can reflash it without desoldering anything. :)
